results.title: Headless writing and composition entrypoints
results.summary: Implemented headless write-for composition entrypoints: registry-backed model runner, prompt engine, guarded service, command and event adapters, plus tests and supporting fixtures/docs. All declared validation commands passed. — The prior blocking issues are addressed: model execution now uses the installed complete(...) registry API, and the event adapter passes a composed abort signal so accept failures abort scheduled work even with a caller signal. The remaining issue is non-blocking cleanup in the AbortSignal.any fallback. Ready to commit after considering that listener cleanup improvement.
findings: medium/performance packages/write-for/src/events.ts:39 — Fallback signal composition adds abort listeners to the caller signal but never removes them when the rewrite completion settles, so runtimes without AbortSignal.any can accumulate per-event listeners → Return a disposable composed signal and remove both listeners after completion/accept failure
